added_comments.text: Precedence (lowest to highest): defaults, config file, APP_* env vars

rationale: The agent removed the _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround entirely and fixed mergeLayers ordering so env vars always take precedence over the file, addressing the whole class of bugs rather than adding APP_CACHE__TTL_SECONDS as a new special case.
